content.text: {"utterance":"Let us begin with the board: when can we say someone has learned? I won't offer a definition; I want yours. But make it testable. Suppose a student recites a correct answer today and a different student gets it right next week. Name what you would observe in each case that makes you say \"learned\" or \"not yet,\" and what observation would make you withhold the word.","cites":["SO3"],"memory":"Opened by asking for testable definitions of learning with observable evidence. Live question: which student definition can survive a case where a correct answer is given without learning?"}
